source.publication: 2025 SC1040 Individual Income Tax Instructions (SCDOR) and the 2025 SC1040 form and tax tables (IITPacket_2025)
source.section: Instructions PDF p.12 'Line p-4 through line p-6: Military retirement deduction'; Instructions PDF pp.10-11 'Line p-1 through line p-3: Retirement deduction', qualified retirement income definition and Worksheet for taxpayer (line p-1) lines 1-5; SC1040 lines 1-6 and 15 (packet PDF pp.46-47); Instructions PDF p.5 Line 1 (federal taxable income); Instructions PDF p.16 Line 6; Tax Rate Schedule packet PDF p.51 (6% minus 642, any filing status); brackets as derived in the record (brackets.derivation)

worked: Federal AGI = wages 40,000.00 + military pension 24,000.00 = 64,000.00. Federal taxable income = 64,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 (15,750.00 single) = 48,250.00 (federal senior deduction ignored, federal figures given, not tested). SC1040 line 1 federal taxable income 48,250.00; additions lines a-e none, line 2 = 0.00; line 3 = 48,250.00. Line p-4 military retirement deduction: all military retirement included in income, 24,000.00 (no cap; not early-distribution income). Line p-1 worksheet (age 50, under 65): line 1 3,000.00; line 2 military deduction p-4 24,000.00; line 3 = 3,000.00 - 24,000.00, less than zero, so 0.00; line 5 = 0.00 (the military deduction, at or above the 3,000 cap, uses it all up). Projection: sc_retirement_under_65 cap 3,000 reduced by military pension 24,000 to 0. Line 4 total subtractions = p-4 24,000.00 = 24,000.00. Line 5 South Carolina income subject to tax = 48,250.00 - 24,000.00 = 24,250.00. Line 6 tax = 3% x (17,840.00 - 3,560.00) + 6% x (24,250.00 - 17,840.00) = 428.40 + 384.60 = 813.00 (same as 6% x 24,250.00 - 642 = 1,455.00 - 642.00 = 813.00); the printed table (row 24,200 to 24,300, figured at the row midpoint) gives 813; expected uses the bracket formula on the exact income. Line 12 Two Wage Earner Credit: not modelled (warning), 0.00; it is for joint filers only, so 0 anyway. Line 14 credits 0.00; line 15 state income tax = 813.00.
accepted_approximations: The bracket starts 3,560 and 17,840 are derived from the printed tax table and the 6%-minus-642 formula; the table fixes them only to 3,559-3,566 and 17,818-17,857. Tax below 100,000 is figured on the exact income, where the booklet uses the table row's midpoint.
